title: 第203章 饥渴小寡妇，太不知轻重了！
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李大壮本就火大，被她这么一勾，简直浑身血脉都沸腾起来！

这饥渴小寡妇，太不知轻重了！

“嫂子，别闹了！”李大壮哑声去拉她的手，可拦得住手，却拦不住腿。

而且姜舒盈的玉手太软了，握在手里柔弱无骨，反倒撩拨的李大壮更加心猿意马！

更别提姜舒盈还在若有似无的亲吻着他凸起的喉结，声音娇媚勾魂：

“嫂子没闹，嫂子有经验，保证让你更舒坦……”

“露思姐只是去洗手间了，很快会回来的！”李大壮再火大，也不能刚在这张沙发上跟程露思那啥了，接着又在这儿弄姜舒盈吧？

那也太禽兽了！

“我懂了，只要我们有足够的单独相处的时间，你就可以和嫂子……对吗？”姜舒盈媚眼如丝。

“咳咳，嫂子，我真不懂你在说什么！”李大壮还在装正经。

姜舒盈却已经摸透他了，这小子，最坏了，明明都已经和头野驴似的了，却还得装，勾的人抓心挠肝，越来越骚浪，他才得劲儿呢~

不过，谁让自己喜欢呢~

别的男人再主动，自己也没感觉，偏偏面对这个坏家伙，什么都不做也会落下层层香汗……

姜舒盈越想越难耐，想，太想了……

尤其是一想到李大壮刚才和程露思在这儿做的事儿，她就春心荡漾……

“嫂子，露思姐已经回来了！”李大壮却听到了程露思走路的声音，连忙提醒。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Dazhuang was already very angry, but being hooked by her like this made his blood boil!

This hungry little widow is so ignorant!

"Sister-in-law, stop making trouble!" Li Dazhuang said dumbly and tried to hold her hand, but he could stop her hand but not her legs.

Moreover, Jiang Shuying's jade hands were too soft, and she felt weak and boneless in her hands. On the contrary, Li Dazhuang's teasing was even more distracted!

Not to mention that Jiang Shuying was still kissing his raised Adam's apple, her voice charming and charming:

"Sister-in-law is not making trouble. She has experience and I promise to make you feel more comfortable..."

"Sister Lu Si just went to the bathroom and will be back soon!" No matter how angry Li Dazhuang was, he couldn't just have sex with Cheng Lusi on this sofa and then have sex with Jiang Shuying here, right?

That's too beastly!

"I understand, as long as we have enough time alone, you can be with your sister-in-law... right?" Jiang Shuying's eyes were as silk as silk.

"Ahem, sister-in-law, I really don't understand what you are talking about!" Li Dazhuang was still pretending to be serious.

Jiang Shuying had already figured him out. This kid was the worst. He was already like a wild ass, but he still had to pretend, seducing people and making him more and more arrogant. He was so motivated~

But who do you like?

No matter how other men take the initiative, I don't feel it myself. But facing this bad guy, I will shed layers of sweat even if I don't do anything...

The more Jiang Shuying thought about it, the more unbearable she became. She thought about it so much...

Especially when she thought about what Li Dazhuang and Cheng Lusi did here just now, she felt excited...

"Sister-in-law, Sister Lu Si is back!" Li Dazhuang heard the sound of Cheng Lusi walking and quickly reminded her.
